scope: HBQ route refresh and intentional waiting compared with CBE recovery admission and exact reverse handback; not whole-HBQ parity
sourceIntent: routeWaiting preserves HOLD, inactive synchronized triggers, positive timeout or non-true condition within completion radius plus 50m; distant vehicles may still be considered stuck.

refreshRoute has a three-second group throttle. Commanded vehicles reselect the current waypoint and doMove the effective commander. Other vehicles may end a fixed path, snapshot and delete/recreate the current waypoint with copied properties, then follow eligible mounted crew and enable PATH/MOVE. This aims to wake native planning after relocation or crew changes.
currentImplementation: DrivingAssistStart nativeWaiting adds stationary and unitReady requirements; its separate recovery-order admission uses DrivingRouteGoal, which rejects scripted, timed, attached or synchronized waypoint work even when distant. It does not execute arbitrary condition code.

Leader recovery escalates finite REFRESH/REVERSE/FINAL/EXHAUSTED stages under the same hardDeadline; native goal receipts are distinct from authored waypoints. No delete/recreate waypoint, enableAI reset, fuel creation, repair or teleport is introduced.

DrivingRecoveryRelease proves exact route, seats, native command and cap provenance before retiring rear movement. SIMPLE_BACK waits for actual STOP/motion observation. A native-return request remains observation-only until acknowledgement; issued requests are not travel proof.
confirmedFix: First late cleanup previously bypassed releaseExpired unless releasePending already existed; authored-route STOP/doMove could then occur beyond the original recovery hard deadline. releaseExpired now applies to every resume under its existing exact-ownership call sites, marks pending/unresolved on expiry, and the existing zero-cap hold no longer requires a pre-existing pending marker. No new deadline or retry is granted.
deliberateDepartures: Preserve authored waypoint identity and mission gates instead of cloning waypoint scripts and synchronization.
Preserve mission-disabled AI features and native protected crew tasks.
Retain unresolved issued-command proof rather than treating timeout as rejected movement or successful restoration.
limits: No native stuck-case physical comparison has run in this checkpoint. Plain-MOVE wake-up effectiveness, reverse travel, forward route resumption and performance remain unverified.
This does not establish full HBQ route-memory, crew, gate, traffic or recovery parity; historical index hash drift remains separate.
